in_sanskrit.name: Bappon
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Vishnu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bappon एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name 'Bappon' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bappa' which is a term used to address Lord Vishnu, especially during the festivals of 'Vishwakarma Puja' and 'Ganesh Chaturthi'. The name signifies power, protection and strength.
